description: This file defines application configuration settings loaded from environment variables, including database and authentication parameters. It includes a Settings dataclass, helper functions to retrieve environment variables, and a function to load the settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing application settings loaded from environment variables, including database connection info and auth parameters.

methods.name: str _env(name: str, default: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable, or returns a default if it is missing or blank.

methods.name: str _require_env(name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a required environment variable, raising an error if it is missing or blank.

methods.name: int _get_int(name: str, default: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable and converts it to an integer, or returns a default value.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads and returns an Settings object populated from environment variables, with defaults for development.
